theme: An open calendar, and a trip to pin down.
greeting: The calendar is nearly empty today, Dan — the four girls' passport appointment this morning was the one fixed point. What's left of the day belongs to the Croatia bookings stacking up ahead of the Sept 8 flight.

needsAttention.title: Croatia's last night is still open
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat room and the noon marina transfer from ACI Komolac can only be booked from dry land before you fly Sept 8. Overdue since Aug 23.

needsAttention.title: Two St. Pete nights before the villa
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sun Sept 20 from Croatia but the kids aren't picked up until Tue Sept 22 — the nights of the 20th and 21st still need a place. Overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags, carry-on only; confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and pre-buy if needed — two 55L duffels won't fly as carry-on and counter fees run high. Overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Refundable SUV as the backup
needsAttention.detail: Book a refundable Full-Size SUV for Sept 20 – Oct 5 at TPA unless Mike's car is confirmed en route south. Decision point is Sept 7; a rental cancels free, a missing car on the 22nd costs the Orlando trip.

schedule.title: Passport appointments — 4 kids
schedule.detail: Gateway Mall post office, St. Petersburg; ~1 hour

flagged.title: Croatia crew introductions
flagged.detail: Your instructor Paul and a crewmate have introduced themselves on the Nautilus thread ahead of the Sept 12 course — a self-intro back would be courteous.

flagged.title: TPA rental agreement arrived
flagged.detail: Enterprise sent the full rental agreement for the Tampa pickup — worth filing against the trip's car plan.

inbox.noise: Five Care.com caregiver-applicant alerts and a LinkedIn connection notice.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: Peak-summer tomatoes, cucumbers, and herbs are at their best right now — a composed salad lets each one stand on its own.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The four girls' passport appointment at 9:30 was the morning's one fixed point.
An open calendar, and a stack of Croatia bookings waiting before the Sept 8 flight.
Kids are with you in St. Pete — garden, dinner, a quiet close.
